rights.scope: Archived description for this exact upload expressly permits footage in edited monetized and nonmonetized videos with optional credit. Recordist's current public site confirms free use for video editing with optional credit. Publisher guidance is separate and concerns creative gameplay videos on appropriate sharing platforms. No platform operation or blanket license is inferred.
rights.creditPlacement: KO and EN descriptions only, before the final music credit. Attribute game to Nintendo, recording to Archive 64 / NintendoBlackCrisis, link source, and note selected, muted, and annotated footage.

observedCandidateCues.before: Link glides above the canopy with the river and trees visible in the distance.
observedCandidateCues.action: The view descends to the same woodland floor. At 16–20 s Link moves between visible trunks.
observedCandidateCues.result: The same landscape becomes a space the player traverses. No blocked straight input or collider behavior is established by these frames.
observedCandidateCues.guide: Start on the canopy framing; later place a short hollow guide around the ground opening beside a visible trunk. Clear on cut or foliage occlusion. Keep Link and the stamina indicator unobstructed.

observedCandidateCues.before: Food inventory highlights Spicy Sautéed Peppers and the Eat menu.
observedCandidateCues.action: The item disappears and Link eats. Cold Resistance appears at 05:00 in the inventory.
observedCandidateCues.result: The game returns to snowy traversal and the timer decreases. This shows one environmental rule and a visible response. No unprotected health loss or isolated armor effect is shown.
observedCandidateCues.guide: Use the food name and timed status as separate targets. Preserve the upper-left timer and the right-side temperature warning in the vertical composition.

excludedSource.reason: World of Longplays requires attribution in both the video and description. The episode uses description-only credits.

authoredComparison.renderer: Unity, using shared tree and avatar with identical camera and attempted straight input on both sides
authoredComparison.observedModelResult: At tick 90 the trunk-plus-avatar sweep reaches XZ (0, -0.75). With collision enabled the avatar stops there. With collision disabled it reaches (0, 3). A separately demonstrated detour clears the expanded trunk on all three segments.
authoredComparison.composition: Lock the same camera and framing. Add a short route overlay at the ground plane. Make the attempted continuation visually distinct from the resolved position. Show the detour as a second action after the controlled A/B comparison.
authoredComparison.limits: Self-authored geometric trace only. No Unity render, occlusion, game engine, AI or stealth claim.
